row.proto: void *Game_Customisation_PickRandomEligibleItem(void *customisation, uint32_t packed_key, void *opt_exclude_ids, char apply_filters)
row.notes: Walks the item array self+0x78..+0x80 (stride 0x110) and collects indices of eligible items into a temp vector (allocator self+0x10): skips items whose id (+8) is in the optional exclude list (param_3: vector +8/+0x10, engaged flag +0x20); with apply_filters also skips items whose key is not available for packed_key in the g_FeTile_CustomisationSystem +0x230 table, items whose lookups in self+0x2a8 tables (+400, +800 twice, +0x260) report state != 1, and the item currently equipped (Ent_Get_VehicleCustomisation_Thunk(self+600, self+0x1a8) +0x18/+0x1a). Seeds a 624-word RNG from QueryPerformanceCounter ms, returns items + 0x110*random index or 0 when none, and always resets the exclude optional. Callers 0x141425550 (loops entrant vehicle customisations and rebuilds them), 0x1416e5e40 (loops g_FeTile table +0x230 keys) and Game_CustomisationCarAreaVM_RefreshDecalsNode all pass flag 1 and apply the returned item to a customisation record (0x141426cc0, 0x141427260, 0x141427730) before Ent_EntrantsSystem_ReplaceVehicleCustomisation. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
